name: IDFC First Bank Limited

name: IDFC First Bank Limited
remarksWeb: The Bank has allotted 8,17,403 equity shares under Employee Stock Option Scheme on September 27, 2021 out of which 1,42,850 equity shares were credited in the temporary ISIN IN8092T01018 in the CDSL system on September 30, 2021 and 6,74,553 equity shares in the NSDL system on October 1, 2021.  The Bank received the listing/ trading approval of 8,17,403 equity shares on BSE and NSE with effect from October 5, 2021 and on the same day the said shares were credited to regular ISIN INE092T01019.  As the allotment of these equity shares and Corporate Action execution to NSDL was already made before September 30, 2021, the entire 8,17,403 equity shares have been considered and reported herewith under Dematerialized category.
